boxDetector.rule: an object with <= 12 triangles (or a BoxGeometry) that is larger than 1 m in two axes or 1 m³ in volume

flatColour.rule: a visible surface material near the track without albedo map and without normal map (glass, emissive lamps and water excepted)

textures.rule: albedo / normal / layer textures of surfaces near the track at least 1024 px, the asphalt 2048 px
